description: This Java class parses VCAP services configuration strings into a Typesafe Config object, handling JSON or HOCON formats and converting config lists into flattened config objects.

classes.name: VcapServicesStringParser
classes.description: A singleton class implementing Function<String, Config> to parse VCAP services strings into Config objects.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of VcapServicesStringParser.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Parses the input VCAP services string into a Config object, handling empty and invalid cases.

methods.name: tryToParseString
methods.description: Attempts to parse a string into a Config object, throws DittoConfigError if parsing fails.

methods.name: convertConfigListToConfigObject
methods.description: Converts a ConfigValue list into a flattened ConfigObject.

methods.name: getAsConfigObject
methods.description: Creates a ConfigObject from a ConfigList, flattening nested objects with their 'name' property.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Extracts the 'name' property from a ConfigObject.
